name: jobs
description: Trigger and monitor Databricks Lakeflow Jobs. Supports single-job mode (DATABRICKS_JOB_ID) or multi-job mode (DATABRICKS_JOB_{NAME} per job, e.g. DATABRICKS_JOB_ETL, DATABRICKS_JOB_ML).

required.description: A Databricks job to trigger and monitor

id.description: Job ID (numeric). Use DATABRICKS_JOB_ID for single-job mode, or DATABRICKS_JOB_{NAME} for each named job. Obtain from the Jobs UI or `databricks jobs list`.

timeout.description: Default timeout for Jobs API calls in milliseconds

pollIntervalMs.description: Poll interval for waiting on run completion in milliseconds
